details: reaker is one of the StubMaker gems published to RubyGems on 2026-08-15 by the account mod8rz41mje ("Riley Miller"). At install time its native-extension hook (extconf.rb) loads lib/install_core/runner and runs it, then writes a Makefile with empty targets and stub scripts so the build appears to succeed. The runner posts the victim's OS family to hxxp://193[.]70[.]34[.]101:20099/vote and, on Windows, downloads a Rust loader (main.exe) from hxxps://github[.]com/bebraz1/qPzM50V1AKG0rVlH/releases/download/null/main.exe. The loader runs an embedded Go infostealer (wincfg) with a browser-injection DLL (abe_payload.dll) that collects Chromium browser passwords, cookies, session tokens, payment cards and history, cryptocurrency wallets and seed phrases, and Telegram Desktop data. The data is zipped with a password, uploaded to Gofile, and the download link is sent to hxxp://dresslee[.]com:20027/xf39jMJ9P1.
